prompt.adult: In John 3:16, whom did God give because He loved the world?

verses.text: For God so loved the world that He gave His only begotten Son, that whoever believes in Him should not perish but have everlasting life.

explanation.adult: John 3:16 says God loved the world and gave His only begotten Son. The answer is His only begotten Son.

teaching.extended_explanation: The gift in this verse is a person, not an angel, a city, or a temple. God gave His only begotten Son so that whoever believes in Him should not perish but have everlasting life. The answer is His only begotten Son.
teaching.takeaway: God gave His only begotten Son.
